description: This Java class 'CategoryWorker' provides utility methods for handling product categories in an e-commerce system, including retrieving categories, managing category trails, checking product-category relationships, and generating category trees.

classes.name: CategoryWorker
classes.description: Utility class for managing product categories, category trails, and related operations in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategory
methods.description: Retrieves the top category for the catalog based on request parameters, session, or default properties.

methods.name: getCategoriesWithNoParent
methods.description: Fetches categories that have no parent categories.

methods.name: getRelatedCategories
methods.description: Fetches related categories based on a request parameter or parent category ID.

methods.name: getRelatedCategoriesRet
methods.description: Returns a list of related categories, with options for limiting view, excluding empty categories, and recursion.

methods.name: isCategoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a category has no members and no subcategories.

methods.name: categoryMemberCount
methods.description: Counts the number of products in a category.

methods.name: categoryRollupCount
methods.description: Counts the number of subcategories (rollups) under a category.

methods.name: setTrail
methods.description: Sets the breadcrumb trail for category navigation.

methods.name: adjustTrail
methods.description: Adjusts the breadcrumb trail based on current and previous categories.

methods.name: getTrail
methods.description: Retrieves the current breadcrumb trail from session.

methods.name: setTrail
methods.description: Stores the breadcrumb trail in session.

methods.name: checkTrailItem
methods.description: Checks if a category is in the breadcrumb trail.

methods.name: lastTrailItem
methods.description: Returns the last category in the breadcrumb trail.

methods.name: isProductInCategory
methods.description: Checks if a product belongs to a specific category, including variants.

methods.name: filterProductsInCategory
methods.description: Filters a list of product value objects to those in a specific category.

methods.name: getCategoryContentWrappers
methods.description: Builds a map of category content wrappers for a list of categories.

methods.name: getCategoryTrail
methods.description: Generates a complete category trail from root to a specific category for export or indexing.
